text:
Alice M.: Quick FYI — Product is deprecating v1 SDK generate/embeddings endpoints on 2026-01-15. We need a short migration guide + 2 minimal examples (JS + Py) for the docs site. I started a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :wave:
Ben K.: Thanks. Do we have a recommended mapping table? e.g. `client.generate` -> `client.responses.create` ?
Alice M.: Yep. Recommended mapping in the draft:
```
// v1 JS
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-large', prompt });

// v2 JS
const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-v2-large', input: prompt });
```
Also embeddings: `client.embed` -> `client.embeddings.create`.
Carol R.: Can we include a short Python example too and a note about streaming differences? Streaming API is similar but now uses `client.stream.responses` helper.
Tim L.: Also call out model name changes — some customers rely on `rwd-large-quant` which will become `rwd-v2-large-q8`. Add a migration note and fallback suggestion.
Alice M.: Good call. I'll add a small table: v1 name -> v2 name + compatibility note.
DocsBot: PR opened by @alicem in redwood-inference/docs (#1234) — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — reviewers: @benk, @carolr
Ben K.: Quick question on the SDK break: are function/tool-calling payloads the same shape? I ran a quick test and had to rename `tools` -> `functions` key.
Alice M.: Yep: v1 `tools: [...]` becomes v2 `functions: [...]` and the call format changed slightly. I'll include a diff snippet.
```
// v1 payload
{
  tools: [{ name: 'search', ... }],
  input: 'Find docs about caching'
}

// v2 payload
{
  functions: [{ name: 'search', ... }],
  input: 'Find docs about caching'
}
```
Carol R.: Can you also mention the rounding behavior for new token-costs? finance flagged that billing will be per-subtoken now and wants a short blurb so customers aren't surprised.
Alice M.: Will add a note under "Billing & compatibility" and link to the pricing page.
Tim L.: For tests/examples — please include one snippet that shows the `responses` output shape and where to find generated text vs. tool results. Tiny snippet is OK.
Alice M.: Plan: update PR today with: mapping table, JS + Py examples, function-calling diff, streaming note, model-name table, billing blurb. @Ben @Carol quick review after I push?
Ben K.: I'll review after lunch.
Carol R.: Happy to review. Add me as a reviewer on the PR once you push. :+1:
Alice M.: Pushed changes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234/files — highlights in docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md
DocsBot: @benk requested changes on files: docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md — comments: 3
Ben K.: Left two small suggestions: clarify streaming examples and tighten wording on the model-name table.
Alice M.: Addressed comments and added a small test snippet for the SDK e2e.
Tim L.: Looks good from infra perspective. Make sure the example uses short-timeout defaults so our CI won't flake.
Alice M.: Good catch, set timeout to 5s in examples. Anything else?
Carol R.: Maybe a one-liner at top: "If you cannot migrate by Jan 15, contact support to request extended access" — saves lots of support threads.
Alice M.: Added that. Thanks everyone — merging after CI passes. :rocket:
